name: orbis
description: Self-hosted, open-source team of persistent AI bots with their own computer, memory, skills, routines and approvals — driven by API models or by agent CLIs you already subscribe to.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/hub packages/cli && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared packages/hub packages/cli && npm run build -w @orbis/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev:hub: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve
